info.name: Sanad App — Community and feedback
info.description: Authenticated Community reads/writes, check-ins, ratings, and app feedback. Posts are moderated before publication. Use Sanad.local.postman_environment.json and supply a disposable access token.

item.name: List published posts
item.description: Authenticated read. Only Published posts are returned. Optional filters: search (case-insensitive titles+contents), categoryId, fromDate/toDate (UTC creation, inclusive), sort=Newest|Oldest|MostLiked (default Newest; other values return 400 Community.InvalidSort). Items carry additive per-user fields categoryId, categoryArabicName, categoryEnglishName, isLiked, isFavorited, currentUserRating.

item.name: List favorites
item.description: Caller's favorited published posts, newest-favorited-first. Same post shape (incl. per-user fields) as the posts feed.

item.name: Get published post
item.description: Unknown or pending/rejected posts return 404. Response includes additive per-user fields (isLiked, isFavorited, currentUserRating) and category fields.

item.name: Create post (pending review)

body.raw:
{
  "titleArabic": "نصيحة يومية",
  "titleEnglish": "Daily care tip",
  "contentArabic": "تذكّر شرب الماء.",
  "contentEnglish": "Remember to drink water.",
  "imageUrl": null,
  "isAnonymous": false,
  "categoryId": null
}

item.description: The author comes from the JWT. Success creates PendingReview; capture the returned id for moderation. categoryId is optional; unknown ids return 400 Community.InvalidCategory and inactive categories return 409 Community.CategoryInactive.

item.name: Report published post
item.description: Authenticated Community user only; published posts only and authors cannot report their own post. reasonCode is Spam|HarassmentOrAbuse|HarmfulOrUnsafeContent|MisleadingOrFalseInformation|Other; Other requires a note. Notes are trimmed plain text up to 1000 characters. A repeat returns the retained report; reporting does not hide the post. Own/non-published target returns 409; unknown post returns 404.

item.name: Upload post image
item.description: Multipart upload (jpeg/png/webp, 2 MB default limit). Returns 201 with imageId and a gated file URL. Stored privately; creates no post. Select a local image file for the file field before sending.

item.name: Read uploaded image
item.description: Uploader, moderator, or published-post readers only; otherwise 404. No-store response.

item.name: Add or update rating
item.description: value is an integer from 1 to 5. Out-of-range or non-integer values return 400 Community.Rating.Invalid. Re-submitting updates the caller's rating.

item.name: Submit local-day check-in
item.description: One row per user/post/local date. Invalid time zones return Community.CheckIn.Invalid.

item.name: Get personalized recommendations
item.description: Authenticated read. Published posts only, affinity authors first, already-interacted posts excluded. No totalCount is returned.

item.name: Delete own comment
item.description: Deletion is blocked when the comment has replies.

item.name: Submit app rating
item.description: Authenticated identity is assigned by the server; rating must be 1–5.

item.name: List active categories
item.description: Authenticated read. Active categories only, ordered by creation time then id. Bare list of {id, arabicName, englishName}.
